title: Enforce output schema in standalone Skill verification
goal: Make SkillRuntime.verify return false when output JSON violates a declared output schema, even if the executor verifier accepts it.
context: executeVerified already validates constrained output against manifest.outputSchema before accepting executor verification. The public verify(id:outputJSON:) API currently calls only executor.verify, so a permissive registered executor can report true for schema-invalid output when callers use verification independently. Keep the existing unconstrained empty-schema compatibility behavior.
forbidden_changes: Do not change ordinary execute semantics or policy/approval behavior.
Do not weaken SkillJSONSchemaValidator or accept unsupported schema keywords.
Do not change executor resolution, capability grants, or Agent scope.
acceptance_criteria: SkillRuntime.verify returns false when output violates a non-empty manifest output schema, even if the executor verifier returns true.
Valid schema-conforming output still delegates to the executor verifier.
The legacy empty output schema {} remains unconstrained for compatibility.
Regression coverage proves standalone verification fails closed for missing required properties and disallowed additional properties.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Revert the single logical task change if the regression or required CI fails; keep Issue #347 open for the remaining Skill-to-Tool acceptance work.
